title: Measurement: the conditional install was permanently true, and the three branches after the repair
summary: The launcher's install condition compared `package-lock.json`'s mtime against the `node_modules` DIRECTORY mtime. Measured on this checkout: package-lock.json 2026-09-04T01:30:58Z, node_modules directory 2026-08-18T18:25:26Z, node_modules/.package-lock.json 2026-09-04T01:30:58Z — so the comparison was true and had been since the first install, because a directory's mtime moves only when an entry is added or removed at its top level while `npm install` rewrites files inside it and touches the lockfile. Consequence observed by hand: `PORT=4415 node bin/start-shell.mjs` printed `installing dependencies…` and npm reported `up to date, audited 279 packages in 2m` — a two-minute install on a checkout with nothing to do, on every start. It surfaced only because a second real launch was added to the launcher suite and timed out after 300s waiting for readiness. After repairing the comparison to npm's installed-tree marker, the same two launches took 8.9s and 8.5s. The three branches ACC-0033 now names are exercised directly over temporary directories: a cold checkout installs; a warm checkout whose lockfile is not newer than the marker skips; a missing marker installs, including when there is no lockfile at all — the case that depends on the marker being checked BEFORE the lockfile. A regression control asserts that a day-old `node_modules` directory mtime is not treated as a stale install, which is the ordinary state of every checkout after its first install.

omissions.reason: npm writes `node_modules/.package-lock.json` on every platform, but the mtime comparison was only observed on Windows. Nothing here measures whether a POSIX filesystem's timestamp granularity could make a same-second install and lockfile write compare equal; the branch would skip an install it should have run.

The cold branch is exercised over a temporary directory rather than by a real `npm install`. EVD-0074 measured the real cold install for the original criterion and still supports that clause; this record adds only the warm and missing-marker branches.
